schema: CREATE INDEX thread_messages ON thread_events(thread_id,seq) WHERE kind='message'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX thread_order ON thread_heads(ordinal)

CREATE TABLE thread_action_calls(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,start_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,finish_seq INTEGER,elapsed_s REAL,failed INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(thread_id,start_seq))
CREATE TABLE thread_action_tags(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,tag TEXT NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,tag))

CREATE TABLE thread_action_totals(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,total_s REAL NOT NULL,max_s REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,name,status))
CREATE TABLE thread_activation_phases(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,phase TEXT NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,total_s REAL NOT NULL,max_s REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,phase))

CREATE TABLE thread_activation_totals(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,total_s REAL NOT NULL,max_s REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,status,reason))
CREATE TABLE thread_artifacts(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,reference TEXT NOT NULL,artifact TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,reference))

CREATE TABLE thread_chunks(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,chunk INTEGER NOT NULL,
        raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,payload BLOB NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,seq,chunk))
CREATE TABLE thread_counts(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,total INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE thread_events(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,publish_step INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,seq))

CREATE TABLE thread_heads(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        provider_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,message_count INTEGER NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,moment TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE thread_input_cursors(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,consumer TEXT NOT NULL,event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,context_seq INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,consumer))
CREATE TABLE thread_tool_receipts(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,call_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,message_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,call_id))
CREATE TABLE thread_usage_actors(call_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(call_id,actor))

CREATE TABLE thread_usage_calls(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL,responses INTEGER NOT NULL,errors INTEGER NOT NULL,input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,input_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,output_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,total_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL,decode_errors INTEGER NOT NULL,embedding_uses INTEGER NOT NULL,duration_s REAL NOT NULL,queue_s REAL NOT NULL,jitter_s REAL NOT NULL,provider_s REAL NOT NULL,duration_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,queue_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,jitter_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,provider_reports INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE thread_usage_totals(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL,responses INTEGER NOT NULL,errors INTEGER NOT NULL,input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,input_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,output_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,total_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL,decode_errors INTEGER NOT NULL,embedding_uses INTEGER NOT NULL,duration_s REAL NOT NULL,queue_s REAL NOT NULL,jitter_s REAL NOT NULL,provider_s REAL NOT NULL,duration_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,queue_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,jitter_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,provider_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,model))
